einzeiler: Comedian Connor Larson joins the dads to talk about impending fatherhood and old times.
kurzfassung: Comedian Connor Larson joins the hosts to discuss his upcoming journey into fatherhood and share stories from the early days of their comedy careers. The group swaps memories of living in notoriously terrible apartments and reflects on the unique eccentricities of their own fathers. They also read through humorous listener submissions about accidental dad quotes and meal routines.
stichpunkte: Connor Larson is welcomed to the podcast as an expecting father entering the Nashville comedy world.
The hosts and guest reminisce about crashing on each other's couches in terrible apartments with broken roofs and no heat.
Tom Riles shares his unconventional system of taking written minutes and keeping track of arrivals at house parties.
The panel discusses the awkward realities of getting massages and how male masseuses handle clients.
Connor talks about his meticulous touring habits, including vacuum-sealing homemade meals for hotel rooms.
The group reads listener responses sharing the most stereotyped dad phrases they have accidentally uttered.
They discuss generational parenting styles, the pendulum effect of child-rearing, and receiving unsolicited life advice from their fathers.

clips.hook: Living 18 months without heat in an apartment
clips.text: After his brother repeatedly complained about the indoor temperature, a phone call to the utility company revealed that the heating had been shut off for a year and a half.

clips.hook: Strict self-imposed rules for watching television
clips.text: To avoid feeling unproductive, the speaker maintains a rigid personal policy against watching historical sports replays instead of current broadcasts or attending to garden chores.

clips.hook: Unhelpful financial advice delivered to a seven-year-old
clips.text: Recalling a father's recurring stock phrases, the speaker notes how strange it was to be repeatedly warned that banks hate poor people at just seven years old.

clips.hook: The skyrocketing cost of college versus comedy
clips.text: Reflecting on modern economic realities, the conversation highlights how spending tens of thousands of dollars on a university degree offers little job security compared to pursuing stand-up.

clips.hook: Packing four pounds of steak for a road trip
clips.text: To maintain healthy eating habits while touring, the comedian admits to packing multiple tupperware containers filled with home-cooked meat to eat in hotel rooms.

beschreibung:
Episode #17 of Life of Dad welcomes comedian Connor Larsen as he joins Tom Riles, Lee Kimbrell, and Mike James for a conversation about preparing for fatherhood and the life changes that come with becoming a dad. From the anticipation of welcoming a first child to reflecting on early adulthood, first apartments, and the experiences that shape us, the guys share stories about growing up, marriage, and the unexpected lessons that come with each new season of life.
The episode also features plenty of laughs as the conversation takes its usual unexpected turns, including unforgettable massage stories, travel experiences, everyday routines, and the little moments that somehow become the funniest memories. As always, the episode is filled with relatable conversations, honest reflections, and the kind of tangents that every parent and soon-to-be parent can appreciate.
Funny, heartfelt, and full of the excitement that comes with stepping into a new chapter, Episode #17 is a reminder that no matter how much advice you receive, becoming a dad is a journey you can only truly understand once you experience it yourself.
